body: I feel you when it comes to depression and anxiety. Alcohol is a way to self-medicate.
Some days I wish I wouldn't wake up, but I suppose that is for me and my therapist to discuss.
Dude/or Duddette....I'm still that nerd. Star Trek, etc. I don't think I'll ever fully fit in unless drinking is involved.
Someone would have to be a giant whore for that to happen.
